concept.subject: A long, narrow wooden boat seen from above on rippled turquoise water, shaped like a fish: a pointed bow for its head, a canopy over its middle and a long tail shaft trailing from its stern.
concept.composition: The boat lies diagonally right of the middle, its bow at four fifths of the width near the top and its stern just right of the center at three quarters of the height; the tail shaft trails from the stern down toward the bottom. Rippled open water fills the rest, the top center included.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 147. The boat is a closed peg outline of its hull with one peg on the tail shaft, 21 pegs that glide together forward and back along the boat's own heading on one horizontal cycle turned to that heading, and keep the band they sweep free. The water under the cannon stays open; three short rows of swell fill each top corner, and six rows of wave crests cross the lower three fifths from wall to wall, broken where the boat glides, the lowest two kept clear of the flippers' swing.

moving.what: the fish boat, 21 pegs moving as one

features: A moving fish shape (spec 8): a fish-shaped boat gliding through the cove

difficulty.note: Second hardest: the open water under the cannon leaves the nearest pegs in the top corners and on the gliding boat, so the orange pegs spread out instead of gathering in one easy patch.

background.prompt: An aerial photo of one long, narrow wooden boat on rippled turquoise water. The boat lies diagonally right of the middle: its pointed bow, with a muted red tip, at about four fifths of the width and a sixth of the height, its blunt stern just right of the center at about three quarters of the height; a gray canopy covers its middle and a long thin tail shaft trails from the stern down to about half the width near the bottom. Small ripples cover the water everywhere, a little darker toward the lower middle and the top right corner. No shore, no sky; the top center and the lower corners are plain water.

picture.title: Aerial photo of a lone wooden boat floating on turquoise water, creating serene ripples.
picture.author: Mikhail Nilov
